Updated Cloud module deployed, HTTPS 200, unauthenticated membership request 401. Two real account and role-revocation iPhone acceptance still open. 2026-11-16: 40 membership/guest ACL tests passed; owner-only pending invite list and revocation deployed, disabled guests filtered from member listings. Protected Cloud API 401 unauthenticated; full owner GUI and real account/iPhone acceptance remain outstanding. Manual 2026-11-16: owner/member controls still absent from Final Master despite API and deployed join path; cannot mark verified before two-account iPhone LAN/Cloud ACL and revocation test.
